summary: Frontend routes/pages for homepage, named reactions index, and individual reaction pages are implemented with a consistent theme and a click-to-zoom image viewer. However, the diff does not show the required generated image assets being added under frontend/public/assets/generated. There are also extra (unrequested) Internet Identity/react-query/actor plumbing and a caffeine.ai footer attribution link.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the generated handwritten-notes images and any decorative images as static frontend assets and render them directly from the frontend (do not fetch images from the backend).
missing_requirements.reason: UI code references images under /assets/generated, but the diff summary does not include any added files under frontend/public/assets/generated (or any image files at all), so the acceptance criterion that the required generated images exist in that directory is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication context/provider and authenticated actor creation hooks (react-query based), despite auth being optional and not required for the static notes site.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not ask for authentication or backend actor access for this feature set; the notes are to be served from static assets without backend calls.

hallucinated_features.description: Footer attribution/link to caffeine.ai (including a 'Built with ♥' line).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires the homepage credit text "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA"; it does not request additional third-party attribution links in the footer.

hallucinated_features.description: Addition of an empty backend Motoko actor.
hallucinated_features.reason: Backend is not required for the requested static-assets notes site; adding an empty actor is extra implementation not requested.
